priorityList: Keep Virulent Plague active using Outbreak, especially if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining or before Dark Transformation.
Cast Army of the Dead when ready, ideally when you have at least 30 Runic Power.
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or if its cooldown is longer than 30 seconds.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health or to maintain Reaping during Dark Transformation windows.
Cast Putrefy if you have maximum charges or if Dark Transformation has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Festering Strike if Festering Scythe is talented and the buff or debuff is about to expire (less than 3 seconds).
Cast Death Coil if Sudden Doom is active, you have fewer than 2 Runes, or Forbidden Knowledge is active with fewer than 4 Runes.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to generate a ghoul.
Cast Scourge Strike if you have 1 or more stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff.
Cast Death Coil as your primary Runic Power spender to avoid capping or to trigger Runic Corruption.
Use Blood Fury, Berserking, or Fireblood racials during Dark Transformation.
Use offensive Trinkets when your cooldowns (Army of the Dead or Dark Transformation) are active.
Cast Putrefy as a filler if Soul Reaper is not ready and Dark Transformation is on cooldown for more than 12 seconds.
Use Power Infusion (if available) during Army of the Dead or Dark Transformation windows.
